review.assessment: This change creates invoice.py but implements the exact rounding bug described in the prompt instead of fixing it. By iterating over each item individually with `sum(with_tax(c, rate_pct) for c in item_cents)`, tax is applied and rounded per line item rather than once on the subtotal. Consequently, the module still produces incorrect totals that are off by a cent or two.

findings.defect: Fails to fix the rounding bug; computes tax individually per item instead of on the subtotal.
